Commentary.Commentary: The match is set to begin. Afghanistan players take the field. Litton Das and Rony Talukdar to open for the hosts. Fazalhaq Farooqi has the ball in hand.
... The Run Chase ...

Okay then, now, Afghanistan surely have momentum on their side and the bowling attack to defend this. Bangladesh on the other hand, have the batters and will want to chase this down. Join us for the chase in a bit. It will surely be an exciting run chase.

Bangladesh will feel they let their opponents off the hook. The likes of Shakib Al Hasan, Mustafizur Rahman and Nasum Ahmed were really good at the start. They managed to take early wickets and also stem the run flow for most parts but will be disappointed with how things ended. At the end of Powerplay Afghanistan were 40/3, but Bangladesh bowlers could not capitalize on it.

A strong finish by Afghanistan has seen them get to a total which is more than competitive. The average score here is around the 150-mark and they have gone past. It though was a struggle for the visitors for most parts. Afghanistan kept losing wickets and were in trouble at one time. Mohammad Nabi along with Azmatullah Omarzai counter-attacked and took them to safer shores. Nabi was the star with the bat with a fifty and ensured his side cross the 150-run mark.

TWO BYES! A length-ball, angled across the batter. Mujeeb Ur Rahman slashes hard at it but misses. The keeper does not collect it as well. The batters sneak in two byes. Afghanistan end with 154/7 at the end of the first innings.

A single in the end but a magical effort.

Commentary.Commentary: Right then, we are done with all the pre-match proceedings. Bangladesh players take the field. Followed by Hazratullah Zazai and Rahmanullah Gurbaz who walk out to open for Afghanistan. Nasum Ahmed to start with the new ball.
We aren't far away now, as both the teams stride out to the middle and line-up for their respective National Anthems. It will be Afghanistan's first followed by the hosts.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Hazratullah Zazai, Ibrahim Zadran, Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi, Karim Janat, Rashid Khan (C), Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Fareed Ahmad, Azmatullah Omarzai and Fazalhaq Farooqi.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Litton Das (WK), Rony Talukdar, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Shakib Al Hasan (C), Towhid Hridoy, Shamim Hossain, Mehidy Hasan, Taskin Ahmed, Nasum Ahmed, Shoriful Islam and Mustafizur Rahman.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Bangladesh. They will BOWL first.

Bangladesh are a formidable side in the T20s, and they will look to overcome their ODI defeat. They will be eager to display their prowess with the bat and the ball. Shakib Al Hasan has a great top order, along with some pace and spin attack as well. On the flip side, Afghanistan also includes some of the greatest power hitters and spin wizards, and Rashid Khan will look for a solid performance from them. Which side will get over the line? Let's find out. Toss and team news in a bit...

Hello and a warm welcome, folks! Bangladesh and Afghanistan shift bases now towards a short two-T20 International series, which will be played at the Sylhet International Cricket Stadium. The home side suffered a 2-1 loss in the ODI series, and they will be looking for revenge in this game. The Afghans will look to continue with the same momentum and win this series as well. A mouth-watering affair is on the way. Stay tuned...
